VENDORS MODULE

Purpose:
Display the Vendors screen shown in the ShipGlobal portal.

Current frontend features:
- Customers > Vendors navigation
- Breadcrumb
- All Vendors banner
- Find a Vendor card
- Email search input
- Search button
- Reset button
- Enter-key search

Backend later:
- GET vendor by email
- Vendor list/table
- Vendor details
- Create/update vendor
- API validation
- Database connection

Keep backend/API code outside this folder so the frontend remains clean.
